source_name: GSE178318 scRNA-seq, QC-filtered EPCAM-based epithelial-proxy screen (this repo's own annotate_gse178318_cell_types.py)
claim: CEACAM5 raw-count positivity within QC-filtered (>=500 detected genes, <=15% mito UMI, per-sample 3-SD outlier removal), EPCAM-identified epithelial-proxy cells -- NOT malignancy-confirmed -- for the 3 GSE178318 patients (COL15/COL17/COL18) who actually received preoperative chemotherapy per sample_map.tsv. COL15 (primary RNA_high 59.5%, LM RNA_low 33.3%), COL17 (primary/LM both RNA_low, 20.0%/12.0%), COL18 (primary/LM both RNA_low, 35.6%/23.1%). Epithelial-proxy cell counts are low and concentrated in COL15 (378-841 cells vs 25-360 for COL17/COL18), directionally consistent with the source publication's own report of few EPCs in chemo-treated patients.
provenance: This repository's own canonical DATA/registry/GSE178318/source_manifest.tsv (downloaded 2026-08-11, SHA256-verified; DOI corrected 2026-08-23 to 10.1038/s41421-021-00312-y). QC thresholds and EPCAM-based epithelial identification taken from the source publication's own Methods (Cell Discovery 2021). Malignant-cell confirmation (InferCNV in the source paper) is NOT reproduced here -- epithelial-proxy only.
metadata: n=3 treated patients is a within-cohort descriptive statistic, not a population-prevalence claim. Epithelial-proxy identification is EPCAM-based marker score, not CNV-confirmed malignancy. CEACAM5 count>0 is a permissive dropout-prone proxy.
